Method of Attack: Container escape allowing unauthorized access to host operating system
Order-of-operations flaw with WORKDIR command in runc
Race condition in Buildkit's mount cache handling
Arbitrary deletion of files/directories during Buildkit container teardown
Inadequate privilege checks in Buildkit's GRPC interface leading to privilege escalation
Impacted Systems: Linux distributions using runc and Buildkit
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in container runtime and build tools (runc and Buildkit)
